Authors: Hao Wang, Joshua Bowden, Colton Crosby, Somil Bansal

OOM-Free Alpamayo via CPU-GPU Memory Swapping for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

GPU memory VLA inference autonomous driving model offloading performance prediction

简要说明：提出一种系统级优化框架，通过CPU-GPU内存交换实现内存高效的大规模视觉-语言-动作模型推理，用于自动驾驶，在显存受限的GPU上实现加速且无需修改模型。

TLDR: A system-level optimization framework that enables memory-efficient inference for large Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in autonomous driving, achieving speedups on VRAM-constrained GPUs without model modification.

Abstract: End-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving unify perception, reasoning, and control in a single neural network, achieving strong driving performance but requiring 20-60GB of GPU memory-far exceeding the 12-16GB available on commodity GPUs. We present a framework, which enables memory-efficient VLA inference on VRAM-constrained GPUs through system-level optimization alone, without model modification. Our work proceeds in three stages: (1) Sequential Demand Layering reduces VRAM usage from model-level to layer-level granularity; (2) Pipelined Demand Layering hides parameter transfer time within layer execution time via transfer--compute overlap; and (3) a GPU-Resident Layer Decision Policy, informed by per-module residency benefit analysis, eliminates the residual transfer overhead that pipelining cannot hide. We further propose a performance prediction model that determines the optimal configuration-both the number and placement of resident layers-from a single profiling run with less than 1.3% prediction error across all configurations. Applied to NVIDIA's Alpamayo-R1-10B (21.52GB) on an RTX 5070Ti (16GB), our work achieves up to 3.55x speedup over Accelerate offloading while maintaining full BF16 precision.

摘要（中文）：用于自动驾驶的端到端视觉-语言-动作模型将感知、推理与控制统一在单一神经网络中，虽能实现优异的驾驶性能，但需占用20-60GB的GPU显存，远超消费级GPU常见的12-16GB容量。本文提出一种框架，仅通过系统级优化即可在显存受限的GPU上实现高效能VLA推理，且无需修改模型结构。研究工作分三个阶段推进：（1）顺序需求分层技术将显存占用量化精度从模型级细化至层级；（2）流水线式需求分层技术通过传输-计算重叠机制，将参数传输时间隐匿于层执行时间内；（3）基于模块级驻留效益分析制定的GPU驻留层决策策略，可消除流水线技术无法规避的残余传输开销。我们进一步提出性能预测模型，通过单次性能剖析（预测误差低于1.3%）即可确定最优配置——包括驻留层的数量与布局策略。在RTX 5070Ti（16GB）上应用本框架处理NVIDIA Alpamayo-R1-10B模型（21.52GB）时，相比Accelerate卸载方案实现了3.55倍加速，同时保持完整的BF16精度。

Authors: Seungwoo Roh, Huiyeong Kim, Jong-Chan Kim

SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture VLA

unified multimodal model understanding and generation mixture-of-experts vision-language-action world model

简要说明：提出SenseNova-U1，一种原生统一的多模态模型，整合理解与生成，初步证据显示其在视觉-语言-动作和世界模型场景中具有潜力。

TLDR: Proposes SenseNova-U1, a native unified multimodal model that integrates understanding and generation, showing preliminary evidence of capability in vision-language-action and world model scenarios.

Abstract: Recent large vision-language models (VLMs) remain fundamentally constrained by a persistent dichotomy: understanding and generation are treated as distinct problems, leading to fragmented architectures, cascaded pipelines, and misaligned representation spaces. We argue that this divide is not merely an engineering artifact, but a structural limitation that hinders the emergence of native multimodal intelligence. Hence, we introduce SenseNova-U1, a native unified multimodal paradigm built upon NEO-unify, in which understanding and generation evolve as synergistic views of a single underlying process. We launch two native unified variants, SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT and SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT, built on dense (8B) and mixture-of-experts (30B-A3B) understanding baselines, respectively. Designed from first principles, they rival top-tier understanding-only VLMs across text understanding, vision-language perception, knowledge reasoning, agentic decision-making, and spatial intelligence. Meanwhile, they deliver strong semantic consistency and visual fidelity, excelling in conventional or knowledge-intensive any-to-image (X2I) synthesis, complex text-rich infographic generation, and interleaved vision-language generation, with or without think patterns. Beyond performance, we show detailed model design, data preprocessing, pre-/post-training, and inference strategies to support community research. Last but not least, preliminary evidence demonstrates that our models extend beyond perception and generation, performing strongly in vision-language-action (VLA) and world model (WM) scenarios. This points toward a broader roadmap where models do not translate between modalities, but think and act across them in a native manner. Multimodal AI is no longer about connecting separate systems, but about building a unified one and trusting the necessary capabilities to emerge from within.

摘要（中文）：当前的大型视觉语言模型(VLMs)仍然受困于一个根本性矛盾：理解与生成被割裂为两个独立问题，导致架构碎片化、流程级联化以及表征空间错位。我们认为这种割裂不仅是工程实现上的缺陷，更是阻碍原生多模态智能涌现的结构性局限。为此，我们提出SenseNova-U1——基于NEO-unify构建的原生统一多模态范式，该框架将理解与生成视为同一底层过程的协同视角。我们发布了两个原生统一变体：基于稠密基座（8B）的SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT和基于混合专家模型（30B-A3B）的SenseNova-U1-A3B-MoT。它们从第一性原理出发设计，在文本理解、视觉语言感知、知识推理、智能体决策和空间智能等任务上媲美顶尖的纯理解型VLM。同时，该模型在语义一致性与视觉保真度方面表现卓越，在常规/知识密集型任意到图像（X2I）合成、复杂图文信息图表生成、以及带/不带思维链的交错视觉语言生成等任务中均展现出优势。除性能表现外，我们还详细阐述了模型设计、数据预处理、预训练/后训练及推理策略，以支持社区研究。初步证据表明，我们的模型已超越感知与生成范畴，在视觉语言动作（VLA）和世界模型（WM）场景中表现强劲。这指向更广阔的发展路径：模型不再只是模态间转换，而是以原生方式跨模态思考与行动。多模态AI不再是连接独立系统，而是构建统一系统，并相信必要的能力将从系统内部自然涌现。

Authors: Haiwen Diao, Penghao Wu, Hanming Deng, Jiahao Wang, Shihao Bai, Silei Wu, Weichen Fan, Wenjie Ye, Wenwen Tong, Xiangyu Fan, Yan Li, Yubo Wang, Zhijie Cao, Zhiqian Lin, Zhitao Yang, Zhongang Cai, Yuwei Niu, Yue Zhu, Bo Liu, Chengguang Lv, Haojia Yu, Haozhe Xie, Hongli Wang, Jianan Fan, Jiaqi Li, Jiefan Lu, Jingcheng Ni, Junxiang Xu, Kaihuan Liang, Lianqiang Shi, Linjun Dai, Linyan Wang, Oscar Qian, Peng Gao, Pengfei Liu, Qingping Sun, Rui Shen, Ruisi Wang, Shengnan Ma, Shuang Yang, Siyi Xie, Siying Li, Tianbo Zhong, Xiangli Kong, Xuanke Shi, Yang Gao, Yongqiang Yao, Yves Wang, Zhengqi Bai, Zhengyu Lin, Zixin Yin, Wenxiu Sun, Ruihao Gong, Quan Wang, Lewei Lu, Lei Yang, Ziwei Liu, Dahua Lin

PointForward: Feedforward Driving Reconstruction through Point-Aligned Representations AutonomousDriving

3D Gaussian Splatting driving reconstruction point-aligned representations scene graphs dynamic instances

简要说明：PointForward提出了一种基于点对齐表示和场景图的前馈驾驶重建框架，旨在提升多视图一致性并改进动态实例建模，以服务于自动驾驶。

TLDR: PointForward proposes a feedforward driving reconstruction framework using point-aligned representations and scene graphs to improve multi-view consistency and dynamic instance modeling for autonomous driving.

Abstract: High-fidelity reconstruction of driving scenes is crucial for autonomous driving. While recent feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable fast reconstruction, their per-pixel Gaussian prediction paradigm often suffers from multi-view inconsistency and layering artifacts. Moreover, existing methods often model dynamic instances via dense flow prediction, which lacks explicit cross-view correspondence and instance-level consistency. In this paper, we propose PointForward, a feedforward driving reconstruction framework through point-aligned representations. Unlike pixel-aligned methods, we initialize sparse 3D queries in world space and aggregate multi-view image information via spatial-temporal fusion onto these queries, enforcing explicit cross-view consistency in a single feedforward pass. To handle scene dynamics, we introduce scene graphs that explicitly organize moving instances during reconstruction. By leveraging 3D bounding boxes, our method enables instance-level motion propagation and temporally consistent dynamic representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PointForward achieves state-of-the-art performance on large-scale driving benchmarks. The code will be available upon the publication of the paper.

摘要（中文）：高保真度驾驶场景重建对于自动驾驶至关重要。虽然近期基于前馈的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）方法能够实现快速重建，但其逐像素的高斯预测范式常存在多视角不一致和层状伪影问题。此外，现有方法通常通过密集光流预测建模动态实例，缺乏显式的跨视角对应关系与实例级一致性。本文提出PointForward——一种基于点对齐表征的前馈式驾驶重建框架。与像素对齐方法不同，我们在世界空间中初始化稀疏3D查询点，通过时空融合将多视角图像信息聚合到这些查询点上，在单次前馈过程中强制实现显式的跨视角一致性。为处理场景动态变化，我们引入场景图显式组织重建过程中的运动实例。通过利用3D边界框，本方法实现了实例级运动传播与时间一致的动态表征。大量实验表明，PointForward在大规模驾驶基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。代码将在论文发表后公开。

Authors: Cheng Chi, Xianqi Wang, Hongcheng Luo, Mingfei Tu, Gangwei Xu, Zehan Zhang, Bing Wang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Sida Peng, Xin Yang, Haiyang Sun

TriBand-BEV: Real-Time LiDAR-Only 3D Pedestrian Detection via Height-Aware BEV and High-Resolution Feature Fusion AutonomousDriving

3D pedestrian detection LiDAR Bird's Eye View real-time feature fusion

简要说明：提出了一种用于自动驾驶代理的实时纯LiDAR 3D行人检测方法，使用高度感知的鸟瞰图编码和高分辨率特征融合。

TLDR: Proposes a real-time LiDAR-only 3D pedestrian detection method using a height-aware Bird's Eye View encoding and high-resolution feature fusion for autonomous agents.

Abstract: Safe autonomous agents and mobile robots need fast real time 3D perception, especially for vulnerable road users (VRUs) such as pedestrians. We introduce a new bird's eye view (BEV) encoding, which maps the full 3D LiDAR point cloud into a light-weight 2D BEV tensor with three height bands. We explicitly reformulate 3D detection as a 2D detection problem and then reconstruct 3D boxes from the BEV outputs. A single network detects cars, pedestrians, and cyclists in one pass. The backbone uses area attention at deep stages, a hierarchical bidirectional neck over P1 to P4 fuses context and detail, and the head predicts oriented boxes with distribution focal learning for side offsets and a rotated IoU loss. Training applies a small vertical re bin and a mild reflectance jitter in channel space to resist memorization. We use an interquartile range (IQR) filter to remove noisy and outlier LiDAR points during 3D reconstruction. On KITTI dataset, TriBand-BEV attains 58.7/52.6/47.2 pedestrian BEV AP(%) for easy, moderate, and hard at 49 FPS on a single consumer GPU, surpassing Complex-YOLO, with gains of +12.6%, +7.5%, and +3.1%. Qualitative scenes show stable detection under occlusion. The pipeline is compact and ready for real time robotic deployment. Our source code is publicly available on GitHub.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 安全自动驾驶代理与移动机器人需要快速实时的三维感知能力，尤其针对行人等弱势道路使用者（VRUs）。本文提出了一种新颖的鸟瞰图（BEV）编码方法，将完整的三维激光雷达点云映射至轻量级二维BEV张量，并划分为三个高度带。我们明确将三维检测任务重构为二维检测问题，并基于BEV输出结果重建三维边界框。通过单一网络可一次性完成对车辆、行人及骑行者的检测。网络主干在深层阶段采用区域注意力机制，基于P1至P4层的分层双向颈部融合上下文与细节信息，检测头则通过分布焦点学习预测侧向偏移的定向边界框，并采用旋转交并比损失函数。训练过程中通过通道空间的小幅垂直重分箱和轻度反射率抖动来抑制模型记忆。在三维重建阶段，我们使用四分位距（IQR）滤波器去除噪声及离群激光雷达点。在KITTI数据集上，TriBand-BEV在消费级单GPU上以49帧/秒的速度，分别于简单、中等及困难场景下实现58.7%/52.6%/47.2%的行人BEV平均精度（AP），超越Complex-YOLO模型，提升幅度达+12.6%、+7.5%和+3.1%。定性场景验证显示其在遮挡条件下具备稳定的检测能力。该处理流程结构紧凑，适用于实时机器人部署。相关源代码已在GitHub平台开源。

Authors: Mohammad Khoshkdahan, Alexey Vinel

Cooperative Robotics Reinforced by Collective Perception for Traffic Moderation AutonomousDriving

collective perception humanoid robot traffic moderation V2X non-line-of-sight intersection

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于集体感知和V2X的协作式人形机器人交通协调员，用于在非视距交叉路口检测并物理阻断不安全的汇入行为，并进行了实际部署。

TLDR: This paper introduces a cooperative humanoid robot traffic moderator that uses collective perception and V2X to detect and physically block unsafe merges at non-line-of-sight intersections, with a real-world deployment.

Abstract: Collisions at non-line-of-sight (NLOS) intersections remain a major safety concern because drivers have limited visibility of approaching traffic. V2X based warnings can reduce these risks, yet many vehicles are not equipped with V2X and drivers may ignore in vehicle alerts. Collective perception (CP) can compensate for low V2X penetration by extending the awareness of connected vehicles, but it cannot influence unconnected vehicles. To fill this gap, our work introduces a complementary concept that adds a cooperative humanoid robot as an active traffic moderator capable of physically stopping a vehicle that attempts to merge into an unseen traffic stream. The system operates on two parallel perception pathways. A dual camera infrastructure unit detects the position, speed and motion of approaching vehicles and transmits this information to the robot as a collective perception message (CPM). The robot also receives cooperative awareness messages (CAM) from connected vehicles through its onboard V2X unit and can act as a relay for decentralized environmental notification messages (DENM) when safety events originate elsewhere along the road. A fusion module combines these streams to maintain a robust real time view of the main road. A Zone of Danger (ZoD) is defined and used to predict whether an approaching vehicle creates a collision risk for a merging road user. When such a risk is detected, the robot issues a human-like STOP gesture and blocks the merging path until the hazard disappears. The full system was deployed at the Future Mobility Park (FMP) in Rotterdam. Experiments show that the combined vision and V2X perception allows the robot to detect approaching vehicles early, predict hazards reliably and prevent unsafe merges in real world NLOS conditions.

摘要（中文）：非视距交叉路口的碰撞事故仍是主要的安全隐患，因为驾驶员对临近交通流的可视范围有限。基于V2X的预警系统能够降低此类风险，但许多车辆尚未配备V2X设备，且驾驶员可能忽略车载警报。协同感知技术可通过扩展网联车辆的感知范围弥补V2X渗透率不足的问题，但无法对非网联车辆产生影响。为填补这一空白，本研究提出一种创新方案：引入协作型人形机器人作为主动交通调节器，能够物理拦截试图汇入不可见车流的车辆。该系统采用双并行感知路径：由双摄像头基础设施单元检测临近车辆的位置、速度与运动状态，并通过协同感知消息将其传输至机器人；机器人同时通过车载V2X单元接收网联车辆发送的协同感知消息，并能在道路其他路段发生安全事件时充当去中心化环境通知消息的中继节点。融合模块集成多源数据流，为主干道交通态势构建稳健的实时全景视图。通过设立动态危险区域模型，系统可预测临近车辆是否对汇入道路使用者构成碰撞风险。当检测到风险时，机器人即作出拟人化停车手势并封锁汇入路径，直至危险解除。整套系统已在鹿特丹未来移动公园完成部署。实验表明：融合视觉与V2X的感知方案使机器人能提前检测临近车辆，可靠预测危险态势，并在真实非视距场景中有效阻止不安全汇入行为。

Authors: Mohammad Khoshkdahan, John Pravin Arockiasamy, Andy Flores Comeca, Alexey Vinel

NavOL: Navigation Policy with Online Imitation Learning VLN

online imitation learning navigation policy diffusion policy visual navigation simulation

简要说明：提出了NavOL，一种用于视觉导航的在线模仿学习范式，该范式在模拟环境中使用全局规划器提供的专家轨迹，以滚动更新循环的方式训练扩散策略，可扩展到多个场景并展示出改进的泛化能力。

TLDR: Proposes NavOL, an online imitation learning paradigm for visual navigation that trains a diffusion policy in a rollout-update loop using expert trajectories from a global planner in simulation, scaling to many scenes and demonstrating improved generalization.

Abstract: Learning robust navigation policies remains a core challenge in robotics. Offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift and compounding errors at rollout, while reinforcement learning requires reward engineering and learns inefficiently. In this paper, we propose NavOL, an online imitation learning paradigm that interacts with a simulator and updates itself using expert demonstrations gathered online. Built upon a pretrained navigation diffusion policy that maps local observations to future waypoints, NavOL trains in a rollout update loop: during rollout, the policy acts in the simulator and queries a global planner which has privileged access to the global environment for the optimal path segment as ground truth trajectory labels; during update, the policy is trained on the online collected observation trajectory pairs. This online imitation loop removes the need for reward design, improves learning efficiency, and mitigates distribution shift by training on the policy own explored rollouts. Built on IsaacLab with fast, high-fidelity parallel rendering and domain randomization of camera pose and start-goal pairs, our system scales across 50 scenes on 8 RTX 4090 GPUs, collecting over 2,000 new trajectories per hour, each averaging more than 400 steps. We also introduce an indoor visual navigation benchmark with predefined start and goal positions for zero-shot generalization. Extensive evaluations on simulation benchmarks, including the NavDP benchmark and our proposed benchmark, as well as carefully designed real-world experiments, demonstrate the effectiveness of NavOL, showing consistent performance gains in online imitation learning.

摘要（中文）：学习鲁棒的导航策略仍是机器人领域的核心挑战。离线模仿学习受限于分布偏移和推演中的误差累积，而强化学习则需要奖励函数工程且学习效率低下。本文提出NavOL——一种在线模仿学习范式，通过与模拟器交互并利用在线收集的专家示教进行自我更新。该框架基于预训练的导航扩散策略构建，该策略将局部观测映射为未来路径点，NavOL采用推演-更新的循环训练模式：在推演阶段，策略在模拟器中执行动作，并向拥有全局环境特权的全局规划器查询最优路径段作为真实轨迹标签；在更新阶段，策略通过在线收集的观测-轨迹对进行训练。这种在线模仿循环免除了奖励设计的需求，提升了学习效率，并通过在策略自身探索的推演数据上训练来缓解分布偏移。依托IsaacLab平台的高速高保真并行渲染能力，结合相机位姿与起止点对的域随机化技术，我们的系统在8块RTX 4090 GPU上实现了50个场景的并行扩展，每小时采集超过2000条新轨迹，每条轨迹平均包含400余步。我们还构建了具有预定义起点和终点的室内视觉导航基准测试集，以评估零样本泛化能力。通过在NavDP基准及我们提出的基准上进行大量仿真测试，并结合精心设计的真实世界实验，验证了NavOL的有效性，展示了其在在线模仿学习中持续的性能提升。

Authors: Xiaofei Wei, Chun Gu, Li Zhang

Introducing Environmental Constraints to Grasping Strategies for Paper-Like Flexible Materials Using a Soft Gripper Manipulation

soft gripper grasping strategies flexible materials environmental constraints manipulation primitives

简要说明：本研究利用软体夹爪和环境约束，系统地研究了类纸张柔性材料的抓取策略，包括力学建模和实验评估。

TLDR: This paper studies robotic grasping strategies for paper-like flexible materials using a soft gripper and environmental constraints, including mechanical modeling and experimental evaluation.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation of flexible objects is widely required in both industrial and service applications. Among such objects, paper-like materials exhibit distinct mechanical characteristics compared to cloth, being more sensitive to compressive stress, where minor variations in physical properties can significantly affect grasping. This study systematically investigates grasping strategies for paper-like materials using a universal soft gripper by exploiting environmental constraints. Based on manipulation primitives employed in existing grasping strategies, we proposed systematic grasping strategies for flexible materials by exploiting environmental constraints and analyzed their mechanical and kinematic models. To investigate the influence of materials and working conditions on grasping, an evaluation system for measuring grasping force and success rate was defined and experimentally evaluated. Finally, we summarized the specific workspaces and characteristics of different strategies that can satisfy various task requirements and lead to potential applications in household service robots for grasping planar flexible objects.

摘要（中文）：柔性物体的机器人操控在工业和服务领域均有广泛需求。其中，纸类材料具有与布料截然不同的力学特性——对压缩应力更为敏感，物理性质的微小变化会显著影响抓取效果。本研究通过利用环境约束，系统性地探索了通用软体抓取器对纸类材料的抓取策略。基于现有抓取策略中采用的操作单元，我们提出了利用环境约束的柔性材料系统化抓取方法，并分析了其力学与运动学模型。为探究材料和工作条件对抓取的影响，定义了测量抓取力与成功率的评估体系，并进行了实验验证。最后，我们总结了不同策略的适用工作空间与特性，这些策略能够满足多样化任务需求，并为家服务机器人抓取平面柔性物体提供了潜在应用方向。

Authors: Yi Dong, Yang Li, Jinjun Duan, Zhendong Dai

A Proprioceptive-Only Benchmark for Quadruped State Estimation: ATE, RPE, and Runtime Trade-offs Between Filters and Smoothers Locomotion

state estimation quadruped robot proprioceptive benchmark trajectory error

简要说明：该论文在数据集上对三种用于四足机器人的本体感知状态估计方法进行了基准测试，评估其精度、运行时间和权衡，以指导从业者选择。

TLDR: The paper benchmarks three proprioceptive state estimation methods for quadruped robots on a dataset, evaluating their accuracy, runtime, and trade-offs to guide practitioner selection.

Abstract: We compare three state-of-the-art proprioceptive state estimators for quadruped robots: MUSE [1], the Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (IEKF) [2], and the Invariant Smoother (IS) [3], on the CYN-1 sequence of the GrandTour Dataset [4]. Our goal is to give practitioners clear guidance on accuracy and computation time: we report long-term accuracy (Absolute Trajectory Error, ATE), short-term accuracy (translational and rotational Relative Pose Error, RPE), and per-update computation time on a fixed hardware/software stack. On this dataset, RPEs are broadly similar across methods, while IEKF and IS achieve a lower ATE than MUSE. Runtime results highlight the accuracy-latency trade-offs across the three approaches. In the discussion, we outline the evaluation choices used to ensure a fair comparison and analyze factors that influence short-horizon metrics. Overall, this study provides a concise snapshot of accuracy and cost, helping readers choose an estimator that fits their application constraints, with all evaluation code and documentation released open-source at https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/state_estimation_benchmark for full reproducibility.

摘要（中文）：我们在GrandTour数据集的CYN-1序列上，对四足机器人三种先进的机体状态估计器进行了比较：MUSE[1]、不变扩展卡尔曼滤波（IEKF）[2]以及不变平滑器（IS）[3]。本研究旨在为实践者提供关于精度与计算时间的明确指导：我们在固定的硬件/软件平台上，报告了各方法的长期精度（绝对轨迹误差，ATE）、短期精度（平移与旋转相对位姿误差，RPE）以及单次状态更新的计算时间。在该数据集上，各类方法的RPE结果总体相近，而IEKF和IS的ATE低于MUSE。运行时间结果凸显了三种方法在精度与延迟之间的权衡。讨论部分中，我们概述了确保公平比较的评估选择，并分析了影响短期度量指标的因素。总体而言，本研究提供了精度与计算成本的简明对比，有助于读者根据应用限制选择适合的估计器。所有评估代码与文档已在https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/state_estimation_benchmark开源发布，以确保结果完全可复现。

Authors: Ylenia Nisticò, João Carlos Virgolino Soares, Joan Solà, Claudio Semini

Sampling-Based Follow-the-Leader Motion Planning for Manipulator-Mounted Continuum Robots Manipulation

follow-the-leader motion continuum robots sampling-based motion planning manipulator-mounted confined spaces

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机械臂安装连续体机器人的基于采样的运动规划器，通过解耦的几何方法联合规划机器人构型和基座姿态，实现在狭窄空间中的跟随领导者运动。

TLDR: This paper presents a sampling-based motion planner for manipulator-mounted continuum robots, enabling follow-the-leader motion in confined spaces by jointly planning robot configuration and base pose via a decoupled geometric approach.

Abstract: Follow-the-leader (FTL) motion exploits the unique morphology of continuum robots (CRs) to navigate confined spaces by having the body retrace the path of the tip. While extensively studied, existing FTL methods typically assume a fixed base or a single degree-of-freedom insertion mechanism, limiting their applicability to practical systems in which CRs are mounted on robotic manipulators with fully actuated SE(3) base pose. This paper presents a sampling-based motion planner for FTL motion of manipulator-mounted CRs that jointly considers robot configuration and base pose. The key idea is to decouple global shape search from base pose determination by computing the base pose through a closed-form geometric construction, thereby avoiding iterative optimization during online planning. The approach supports general forward models and enables efficient planning by shifting the majority of computation offline. We establish theoretical guarantees including resolution complete shape search and converging tip tracking throughout waypoint traversal and interpolation. Experiments on 120 simulated paths over 3 test classes demonstrate 0% tip error and 1.9% mean shape deviation (w.r.t. robot length) at 100% success rate. We validate the practicality of our approach on a 6-DOF tendon-driven CR mounted on a serial manipulator. Code and visualization available at https://continuumroboticslab.github.io/sb-ftl-cr-planner/.

摘要（中文）：随形运动"（FTL）利用连续体机器人（CR）独特的形态学特点，通过使机身沿尖端路径回溯，实现在狭小空间中的导航。尽管已有大量研究，但现有的FTL方法通常假设基座固定或仅采用单自由度插入机构，这限制了其在实际情况下的适用性——实际系统中CR通常安装在具有完全驱动SE(3)基座姿态的机械臂上。本文提出一种基于采样的运动规划方法，用于机械臂搭载CR的FTL运动，同时考虑机器人构型与基座姿态。其核心思想是通过闭式几何构造计算基座姿态，将全局形态搜索与基座姿态解耦，从而避免在线规划时的迭代优化。该方法支持通用的正向运动学模型，并通过将大部分计算转移至离线实现高效规划。我们建立了理论保证，包括分辨率完备的形态搜索以及在路径点遍历与插值过程中的尖端轨迹收敛性证明。在3类测试场景的120条仿真路径实验中，该方法实现了0%的尖端误差和1.9%的平均形态偏差（相对于机器人长度），成功率达100%。我们通过安装在串联机械臂上的6自由度肌腱驱动CR验证了该方法的实用性。代码与可视化资料详见https://continuumroboticslab.github.io/sb-ftl-cr-planner/。

Authors: Chengnan Shentu, Nicholas Baldassini, Oluwagbotemi D. Iseoluwa, Radian Gondokaryono, Jessica Burgner-Kahrs

PRISM: : Planning and Reasoning with Intent in Simulated Embodied Environments VLN

diagnostic benchmark embodied agent implicit intent resolution long-horizon coordination photorealistic multi-room

简要说明：PRISM提出一个用于具身智能体的诊断基准，在逼真的多房间公寓中隔离感知、推理和长视野规划等层级的失败原因，并评估多种智能体。

TLDR: PRISM introduces a diagnostic benchmark for embodied agents that isolates failure causes across perception, reasoning, and long-horizon planning tiers, evaluating diverse agents in photorealistic multi-room apartments.

Abstract: When an LLM-based embodied agent fails at a household task, the culprit could be misidentified objects, forgotten sub-goals, or poor action sequencing -- yet existing benchmarks report only a single success rate, making it impossible to tell which cognitive module is responsible. We present PRISM, a diagnostic benchmark that reframes this problem: rather than asking only \textit{did the agent succeed?}, PRISM asks \textit{which capability is most likely responsible for failure?} Built on five photorealistic multi-room apartments (4--8 rooms each), PRISM structures 300 human-verified tasks into three capability tiers -- \textit{Basic Ability}, \textit{Reasoning Ability}, and \textit{Long-horizon Ability} -- that isolate perception-to-action grounding, implicit intent resolution, and sustained multi-step coordination respectively. PRISM exposes an agent-agnostic executable action API that allows arbitrary agents: LLM agents, VLM agents, symbolic planners, RL policies, and hybrid systems, to be evaluated end-to-end under the same benchmark protocol. To support deeper diagnosis, optional probes for perception, memory, and planning can be adopted, replaced, or bypassed entirely, enabling controlled component-level analysis when desired. Experiments on seven contemporary LLMs establish a clear hierarchy: explicit spatial grounding is not the dominant failure source under oracle perception, implicit intent resolution is a significant bottleneck for all model families, and long-horizon coordination exposes a stark capability cliff -- lightweight models collapse to as low as 20.0\% success while simultaneously consuming more tokens than their frontier counterparts, a signature of compensatory over-reasoning rather than genuine planning capability. Project page: \href{https://sj-li.com/PROJ/PRISM}{link}.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 当基于大语言模型（LLM）的具身智能体在家庭任务中失败时，原因可能是对象识别错误、子目标遗忘或动作序列规划不当——然而现有基准测试仅报告单一的成功率，使得我们无法判断具体是哪个认知模块导致了失败。我们提出了PRISM这一诊断性基准测试，它重新构建了这一问题：与其只询问“智能体是否成功”，PRISM更关注“失败最可能由哪种能力缺陷导致？”PRISM基于五个具照片级真实感的多房间公寓（每个公寓包含4至8个房间），将300项经人工验证的任务划分为三个能力层级——基础能力、推理能力与长时程能力——分别用于隔离评估感知-动作映射、隐式意图解析和持续多步骤协调能力。PRISM提供了一种与智能体无关的可执行动作API接口，允许任意类型的智能体——LLM智能体、视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体、符号规划器、强化学习策略及混合系统——在同一基准测试协议下进行端到端评估。为支持深入诊断，该框架可选择性地搭载感知、记忆与规划探测模块，这些模块可被替换或完全绕过，从而实现按需控制的组件级分析。通过对七种当代LLM的实验，我们明确了能力层级关系：在理想感知条件下，显式空间映射并非主要失败原因；隐式意图解析是所有模型家族的显著瓶颈；而长时程协调能力则暴露出明显的能力断层——轻量级模型成功率骤降至20.0%，同时其消耗的令牌数甚至超过前沿模型，这表明其采用了补偿性过度推理而非真正的规划能力。项目页面：\href{https://sj-li.com/PROJ/PRISM}{链接}。

Authors: Yunn Kang Lim, Pengzhan Sun, Ziyi Bai, Xun Xu, Angela Yao, Xulei Yang, Shijie Li

TOPPO: Rethinking PPO for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Critic Balancing RLRobot

Multi-Task RL PPO Critic Balancing Gradient Conditioning Meta-World

简要说明：该论文诊断并修复了用于多任务强化学习的PPO中的评论家侧梯度病态问题，提出了TOPPO，在机器人操作任务上性能超越了SAC基线。

TLDR: The paper diagnoses and fixes critic-side gradient ill-conditioning in PPO for multi-task reinforcement learning, proposing TOPPO which outperforms SAC baselines on robotic manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) and its variants dominate Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning (MTRL) due to their off-policy sample efficiency, while on-policy methods such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) remain underexplored. We diagnose that PPO in MTRL suffers from a previously overlooked issue: critic-side gradient ill-conditioning, which may cause tail tasks to stall while easy tasks dominate the value function's updates. To address this, we propose TOPPO (Tail-Optimized PPO), a reformulation of PPO via Critic Balancing -- a set of modules that improve gradient conditioning and balance learning dynamics across tasks. Unlike prior approaches that rely on modular architectures or large models, TOPPO targets the optimization bottleneck within PPO itself. Empirically, TOPPO achieves stronger mean and tail-task performance than published SAC-family and ARS-family baselines while using substantially fewer parameters and environment steps on Meta-World+ benchmark. Notably, TOPPO matches or surpasses strong SAC baselines early in training and maintains superior performance at full budget. Ablations confirm the effectiveness of each module in TOPPO and provide insights into their interactions. Our results demonstrate that, with proper optimization, on-policy methods can rival or exceed off-policy approaches in MTRL, challenging the prevailing reliance on SAC and highlighting critic-side gradient conditioning as the central bottleneck.

摘要（中文）：软行动者-批评者（SAC）及其变体因其离策略样本效率在多任务强化学习（MTRL）中占据主导地位，而近端策略优化（PPO）等策略方法仍未得到充分探索。我们诊断发现，PPO在MTRL中存在一个先前被忽视的问题：批评端梯度病态性，可能导致尾部任务停滞，而简单任务主导价值函数更新。为解决这一问题，我们提出TOPPO（尾部优化PPO），通过批评者平衡——一组改善梯度条件并平衡任务间学习动态的模块——对PPO进行重构。不同于先前依赖模块化架构或大型模型的方法，TOPPO针对PPO本身的优化瓶颈进行改进。实验表明，在Meta-World+基准测试中，TOPPO以显著更少的参数和环境步数，取得了优于已发表SAC系列和ARS系列基线的平均性能和尾部任务性能。值得注意的是，TOPPO在训练早期即匹配或超越强SAC基线，并在完整训练周期内保持更优性能。消融实验证实了TOPPO中每个模块的有效性，并揭示了模块间的相互作用机制。我们的研究结果表明，通过优化改进，策略方法在MTRL中能够匹敌甚至超越离策略方法，这挑战了当前对SAC的普遍依赖，并揭示批评端梯度条件性是多任务强化学习的核心瓶颈。

Authors: Yuanpeng Li, Gefei Lin, Annie Qu, Rui Miao

Overcoming Dynamics-Blindness: Training-Free Pace-and-Path Correction for VLA Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action inference-time correction dynamics-blindness pace-and-path closed-form

简要说明：提出一种免训练的推理时算子，通过联合优化动作块内的执行节奏和空间路径，纠正VLA模型的动态盲视，提升动态环境中的成功率。

TLDR: Proposes a training-free inference-time operator that corrects dynamics-blindness in VLA models by jointly optimizing pace and path within action chunks, improving success rates in dynamic environments.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve remarkable flexibility and generalization beyond classical control paradigms. However, most prevailing VLAs are trained under a single-frame observation paradigm, which leaves them structurally blind to temporal dynamics. Consequently, these models degrade severely in non-stationary scenarios, even when trained or finetuned on dynamic datasets. Existing approaches either require expensive retraining or suffer from latency bottlenecks and poor temporal consistency across action chunks. We propose Pace-and-Path Correction, a training-free, closed-form inference-time operator that wraps any chunked-action VLA. From a single quadratic cost, joint minimization yields a unified solution that decomposes orthogonally into two distinct channels. The pace channel compresses execution along the planned direction, while the path channel applies an orthogonal spatial offset, jointly absorbing the perceived dynamics within the chunk window. We evaluate our approach on a comprehensive diagnostic benchmark MoveBench designed to isolate motion as the sole controlled variable. Empirical results demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free wrappers and dynamic-adaptive methods and improves success rates by up to 28.8% and 25.9% in absolute terms over foundational VLA models in dynamic-only and static-dynamic mixed environments, respectively.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型在经典控制范式之外展现出卓越的灵活性与泛化能力。然而，当前主流视觉-语言-动作模型大多基于单帧观测范式训练，导致其在结构上无法感知时序动态特性。因此，即使在动态数据集上训练或微调，这类模型在非稳态场景中的性能仍会急剧下降。现有方法或需昂贵的重训练成本，或面临延迟瓶颈及动作片段间时序一致性的问题。我们提出步调-路径校正方法——一种无需训练、封闭形式的推理时算子，可适配任何分块动作的视觉-语言-动作模型。通过单一二次代价函数的联合优化，该方法可分解为两个正交通道的统一解：步调通道沿规划方向压缩执行节奏，路径通道则施加正交空间偏移，二者协同吸收动作窗口内感知到的动态变化。我们在专为隔离运动变量的诊断基准测试集MoveBench上进行评估，实验结果表明，该框架在动态场景及动静混合环境中分别较基础视觉-语言-动作模型的绝对成功率提升28.8%和25.9%，持续优于当前最先进的免训练封装器与动态自适应方法。

Authors: Yanyan Zhang, Chaoda Song, Vikash Singh, Xinpeng Li, Kai Ye, Zhe Hu, Zhongzhu Pu, Yu Yin, Vipin Chaudhary

Behavioral Mode Discovery for Fine-tuning Multimodal Generative Policies Manipulation

generative policies RL fine-tuning behavioral mode discovery mutual information robotic manipulation

简要说明：提出一种无监督模式发现框架，用于在强化学习微调多模态生成策略时保持行为多样性，并在机器人操作任务上进行了实验验证。

TLDR: Proposes an unsupervised mode discovery framework to preserve behavioral diversity during RL fine-tuning of multimodal generative policies, demonstrated on robotic manipulation tasks.

Abstract: We address the problem of fine-tuning pre-trained generative policies with reinforcement learning (RL) while preserving the multimodality of their action distributions. Existing methods for RL fine-tuning of generative policies (e.g., diffusion policies) improve task performance but often collapse diverse behaviors into a single reward-maximizing mode. To mitigate this issue, we propose an unsupervised mode discovery framework that uncovers latent behavioral modes within generative policies. The discovered modes enable the use of mutual information as an intrinsic reward, regularizing RL fine-tuning to enhance task success while maintaining behavioral diversity. Experiments on robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms conventional fine-tuning approaches, achieving higher success rates and preserving richer multimodal action distributions.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 本文研究了在利用强化学习（RL）对预训练生成策略进行微调时，如何保持其动作分布的多模态特性。现有方法（如扩散策略）虽能提升任务性能，但常导致多样行为坍缩为单一奖励最大化模式。为缓解此问题，我们提出一种无监督模式发现框架，用于揭示生成策略中的潜在行为模式。通过发掘的模式，我们引入互信息作为内在奖励，对RL微调过程进行正则化，在提升任务成功率的同时维持行为多样性。在机器人操作任务上的实验表明，本方法始终优于传统微调方法，在实现更高成功率的同时保持了更丰富的多模态动作分布。

Authors: Alberta Longhini, David Emukpere, Jean-Michel Renders, Seungsu Kim

JACoP: Joint Alignment for Compliant Multi-Agent Prediction AutonomousDriving

Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction Scene Compliance Markov Random Field Social Collisions Environmental Violations

简要说明：JACoP 是一个用于随机人体轨迹预测的多阶段框架，通过基于锚点的以智能体为中心的分析器和基于马尔可夫随机场的对齐器，确保场景级合理性，减少社会碰撞和环境违规。

TLDR: JACoP is a multi-stage framework for stochastic human trajectory prediction that uses an Anchor-Based Agent-Centric Profiler and an MRF-based aligner to ensure scene-level plausibility by minimizing social collisions and environmental violations.

Abstract: Stochastic Human Trajectory Prediction (HTP) using generative modeling has emerged as a significant area of research. Although state-of-the-art models excel in optimizing the accuracy of individual agents, they often struggle to generate predictions that are collectively compliant, leading to output trajectories marred by social collisions and environmental violations, thus rendering them impractical for real-world applications. To bridge this gap, we present JACoP: Joint Alignment for Compliant Multi-Agent Prediction, an innovative multi-stage framework that ensures scene-level plausibility. JACoP incorporates an Anchor-Based Agent-Centric Profiler for effective initial compliance filtering and employs a Markov Random Field (MRF) based aligner to formalize the joint selection for scene predictions. By representing inter-agent spatial and social costs as MRF energy potentials, we successfully infer and sample from the joint trajectory distribution, achieving prediction with optimal scene compliance. Comprehensive experiments show that JACoP not only achieves competitive accuracy, but also sets a new standard in reducing both environmental violations and social collisions, thereby confirming its ability to produce collectively feasible and practically applicable trajectory predictions.

摘要（中文）：基于生成建模的随机行人轨迹预测已成为重要的研究领域。尽管当前先进模型在优化单智能体预测精度方面表现卓越，但往往难以生成具有整体协调性的预测结果，导致输出轨迹存在社交碰撞与环境违规问题，从而限制了实际应用价值。为弥补这一差距，我们提出JACoP：多智能体协调预测联合对齐框架——一种创新的多阶段框架，确保场景级预测的合理性。JACoP采用基于锚点的智能体中心分析器进行高效的初始合规性筛选，并运用基于马尔可夫随机场的对齐器实现场景预测的联合选择机制。通过将智能体间的空间与社会成本建模为MRF能量势函数，我们成功从联合轨迹分布中进行推断与采样，实现了具备最优场景协调性的预测。综合实验表明，JACoP不仅实现了具有竞争力的预测精度，更在减少环境违规和社交碰撞方面设立了新标准，从而证实了其生成集体可行且具有实际应用价值的轨迹预测能力。

Authors: Qingze Liu, Alen Mrdovic, Danrui Li, Mathew Schwartz, Sejong Yoon, Mubbasir Kapadia

PriorZero: Bridging Language Priors and World Models for Decision Making WorldModel

world models LLM priors MCTS reinforcement learning credit assignment

简要说明：提出了一个框架，通过解耦MCTS根节点先验注入和稳定的微调，将LLM概念先验与世界模型规划相结合，以提升文本和网格世界任务中的强化学习决策能力。

TLDR: A framework that integrates LLM conceptual priors with world-model planning via decoupled MCTS root-prior injection and stable fine-tuning for improved RL decision-making in text and gridworld tasks.

Abstract: Leveraging the rich world knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents offers a promising path toward general intelligence. However, a fundamental prior-dynamics mismatch hinders existing approaches: static LLM knowledge cannot directly adapt to the complex transition dynamics of long-horizon tasks. Using LLM priors as fixed policies limits exploration diversity, as the prior is blind to environment-specific dynamics; while end-to-end fine-tuning suffers from optimization instability and credit assignment issues. To bridge this gap, we propose PriorZero, a unified framework that integrates LLM-derived conceptual priors into world-model-based planning through a decoupled rollout-training design. During rollout, a novel root-prior injection mechanism incorporates LLM priors exclusively at the root node of Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), focusing search on semantically promising actions while preserving the world model's deep lookahead capability. During training, PriorZero decouples world-model learning from LLM adaptation: the world model is continuously refined on interaction data to jointly improve its dynamics, policy, and value predictions, its value estimates are then leveraged to provide fine-grained credit assignment signals for stable LLM fine-tuning via alternating optimization. Experiments across diverse benchmarks, including text-based adventure games in Jericho and instruction-following gridworld tasks in BabyAI, demonstrate that PriorZero consistently improves both exploration efficiency and asymptotic performance, establishing a promising framework for LLM-empowered decision-making. Our code is available at https://github.com/opendilab/LightZero.

摘要（中文）：借助大型语言模型（LLM）丰富世界知识来增强强化学习（RL）智能体，是实现通用智能的一条有前景的路径。然而，现有方法存在一个根本性的先验-动态失配问题：静态的LLM知识无法直接适应长时程任务复杂的转移动态。将LLM先验作为固定策略会限制探索多样性，因为该先验对环境特定动态是盲目的；而端到端微调则面临优化不稳定和信用分配问题。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了PriorZero框架，该框架通过解耦的推演-训练设计，将LLM衍生的概念先验整合到基于世界模型的规划中。在推演阶段，一种新颖的根节点先验注入机制将LLM先验仅引入蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的根节点，从而使搜索聚焦于语义上更有前景的动作，同时保留世界模型的长程前瞻能力。在训练阶段，PriorZero将世界模型学习与LLM适配解耦：世界模型基于交互数据持续优化，以协同改进其动态、策略和价值预测；随后利用其价值估计提供细粒度信用分配信号，通过交替优化实现稳定的LLM微调。在多样化基准测试（包括Jericho中的文本冒险游戏和BabyAI中的指令跟随网格世界任务）上的实验表明，PriorZero在探索效率和渐进性能上均取得一致提升，为LLM赋能的决策制定建立了一个有前景的框架。我们的代码已发布于https://github.com/opendilab/LightZero。

Authors: Junyu Xiong, Yuan Pu, Jia Tang, Yazhe Niu

OmniHumanoid: Streaming Cross-Embodiment Video Generation with Paired-Free Adaptation HumanoidEmbodied

cross-embodiment video generation motion transfer embodiment-specific adaptation branch-isolated attention humanoid

简要说明：OmniHumanoid 是一个跨具身视频生成框架，通过解耦运动传递和具身特定适应，利用轻量级适配器和分支隔离注意力设计，为不同人形机器人实现可扩展的数据生成。

TLDR: OmniHumanoid is a framework for cross-embodiment video generation that factorizes motion transfer and embodiment-specific adaptation, enabling scalable data generation for humanoid embodiments using lightweight adapters and a branch-isolated attention design.

Abstract: Cross-embodiment video generation aims to transfer motions across different humanoid embodiments, such as human-to-robot and robot-to-robot, enabling scalable data generation for embodied intelligence. A major challenge in this setting is that motion dynamics are partly transferable across embodiments, whereas appearance and morphology remain embodiment-specific. Existing approaches often entangle these factors, and many require paired data for every target embodiment, which limits scalability to new robots. We present OmniHumanoid, a framework that factorizes transferable motion learning and embodiment-specific adaptation. Our method learns a shared motion transfer model from motion-aligned paired videos spanning multiple embodiments, while adapting to a new embodiment using only unpaired videos through lightweight embodiment-specific adapters. To reduce interference between motion transfer and embodiment adaptation, we further introduce a branch-isolated attention design that separates motion conditioning from embodiment-specific modulation. In addition, we construct a synthetic cross-embodiment dataset with motion-aligned paired videos rendered across diverse humanoid assets, scenes, and viewpoints. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that OmniHumanoid achieves strong motion fidelity and embodiment consistency, while enabling scalable adaptation to unseen humanoid embodiments without retraining the shared motion model.

摘要（中文）：跨形态视频生成旨在实现不同人形形态之间的运动迁移，如人至机器人、机器人至机器人，从而为具身智能提供可扩展的数据生成方法。该领域面临的主要挑战在于：运动动力学具有部分可迁移性，而外观与形态特征则完全依赖于特定形态。现有方法往往将这两类因素混杂处理，且多数需要针对每个目标形态准备配对数据，限制了其向新型机器人的可扩展性。我们提出OmniHumanoid框架，该框架将可迁移运动学习与形态特定适应进行解耦建模。我们的方法通过多形态运动对齐配对视频学习共享的运动迁移模型，同时仅需使用非配对视频即可通过轻量级形态特定适配器实现对新形态的适应。为降低运动迁移与形态适应之间的干扰，我们进一步提出分支隔离注意力机制，将运动条件调节与形态特定调制分离处理。此外，我们构建了合成跨形态数据集，其中包含在不同人形资产、场景及视角下渲染生成的运动对齐配对视频。在合成与真实场景基准测试上的实验表明，OmniHumanoid在保持运动保真度与形态一致性的同时，能够在不重新训练共享运动模型的情况下实现对未见人形形态的可扩展适应。

Authors: Yiren Song, Xiyao Deng, Pei Yang, Yihan Wang, Mike Zheng Shou

XWOD: A Real-World Benchmark for Object Detection under Extreme Weather Conditions AutonomousDriving

object detection extreme weather autonomous driving robust perception real-world dataset

简要说明：推出了XWOD，一个覆盖七种极端天气条件的大规模真实世界物体检测基准，旨在提升自动驾驶交通感知的鲁棒性。

TLDR: Introduces XWOD, a large-scale real-world object detection benchmark covering seven extreme weather conditions, to improve traffic perception robustness for autonomous driving.

Abstract: Autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems remain vulnerable under extreme weather. The U.S. Federal Highway Administration reports that roughly 745,000 crashes and 3,800 fatalities per year are weather-related, and recent regulatory investigations have examined failures of Level-2/3 driving systems under reduced-visibility conditions. However, datasets commonly used to evaluate weather robustness remain limited in scale, diversity, and realism. In this paper, we introduce XWOD (Extreme Weather Object Detection), a large-scale real-world traffic-object detection benchmark containing 10,010 images and 42,924 bounding boxes across seven extreme weather conditions: rain, snow, fog, haze/sand/dust, flooding, tornado, and wildfire. The dataset covers six traffic-object categories, including car, person, truck, motorcycle, bicycle, and bus. XWOD extends the weather taxonomy from one to seven conditions, and is the first to cover the emerging class of climate-amplified hazards, such as flooding, tornado, and wildfire. To evaluate the quality of our data, we train standard YOLO-family detectors on XWOD and test them zero-shot on external weather benchmarks, achieving mAP$_{50}$ scores of 63.00% on RTTS, 59.94% on DAWN, and 61.12% on WEDGE, compared with the corresponding published YOLO-based baselines of 40.37%, 32.75%, and 45.41%, respectively, representing relative improvements of 56%, 83%, and 35%. These cross-dataset results show that XWOD provides a strong source domain for learning weather-robust traffic perception. We release the dataset, splits, baseline weights, and reproducible evaluation code under a research-use license.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶与智能交通系统在极端天气条件下仍显脆弱。据美国联邦公路管理局报告，每年约74.5万起交通事故及3800人死亡与天气因素相关，近期监管调查亦揭示了L2/L3级驾驶系统在低能见度环境中的失效案例。然而，现有评估天气鲁棒性的数据集普遍存在规模有限、多样性不足及真实度欠缺的问题。本文提出XWOD（极端天气目标检测）基准——一个涵盖七种极端天气条件（降雨、降雪、雾、霾/沙尘、洪水、龙卷风及野火）的大规模真实世界交通目标检测数据集，包含10,010张图像及42,924个标注框。数据集覆盖汽车、行人、卡车、摩托车、自行车及公交车六类交通目标。XWOD将天气分类从单一条件扩展至七类，并首次涵盖洪水、龙卷风与野火等气候加剧型灾害场景。为验证数据质量，我们在XWOD上训练标准YOLO系列检测器，并在外部天气基准测试中进行零样本评估，在RTTS、DAWN和WEDGE数据集上分别取得63.00%、59.94%与61.12%的mAP$_{50}$分数，相较于已发布的同类YOLO基线结果（40.37%、32.75%和45.41%）实现56%、83%和35%的相对性能提升。跨数据集实验表明XWOD为学习天气鲁棒的交通感知提供了优质源域。我们将以研究用途许可公开数据集、划分方案、基线模型权重及可复现评估代码。

Authors: Chih-Hsin Chen, Yu-Tung Liu, Amar Fadillah, Kuan-Ting Lai, Dong Liu

EvoNav: Evolutionary Reward Function Design for Robot Navigation with Large Language Models RLRobot

robot navigation reward function design large language models evolutionary framework reinforcement learning

简要说明：EvoNav利用大语言模型和进化框架自动化设计机器人导航奖励函数，通过渐进式三阶段评估高效生成有效策略。

TLDR: EvoNav automates robot navigation reward function design using LLMs and an evolutionary framework with a progressive three-stage evaluation to efficiently produce effective policies.

Abstract: Robot navigation is a crucial task with applications to social robots in dynamic human environments. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown great promise for this problem, the policy quality is highly sensitive to the specification of reward functions. Hand-crafted rewards require substantial domain expertise and embed inductive biases that are difficult to audit or adapt, limiting their effectiveness and leading to suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose EvoNav, an evolutionary framework that automates the design of robot navigation reward functions via large language models (LLMs). To overcome prohibitively costly policy training, EvoNav evaluates each candidate proposal from the LLM via a progressive three-stage warm-up-boost procedure. EvoNav advances from analytical proxies with low-cost surrogates, such as small datasets and analytic rules, to lightweight rollouts and, finally, to full policy training, enabling computationally efficient exploration under effective feedback. Experiment results show that EvoNav produces more effective navigation policies than manually designed RL rewards and state-of-the-art reward design methods.

摘要（中文）：机器人导航是一项关键任务，在动态人类环境中具有社交机器人的重要应用。尽管强化学习（RL）在此领域展现出巨大潜力，但策略质量对奖励函数的设计极为敏感。人工设计的奖励函数不仅需要大量领域专业知识，还嵌入了难以审计或调整的归纳偏置，这限制了其有效性并导致策略性能欠佳。本文提出EvoNav，一种基于大语言模型（LLMs）的进化框架，能够自动化设计机器人导航奖励函数。为克服策略训练成本过高的问题，EvoNav通过渐进式三阶段预热增强流程评估大语言模型生成的每个候选方案：从基于低成本替代（如小数据集与解析规则）的分析性代理开始，逐步过渡到轻量级模拟推演，最后进行完整策略训练，从而在有效反馈下实现高效计算探索。实验结果表明，EvoNav生成的导航策略相较于人工设计的强化学习奖励函数及现有最先进的奖励设计方法具有更优性能。

Authors: Zhikai Zhao, Chuanbo Hua, Federico Berto, Zihan Ma, Kanghoon Lee, Jiachen Li, Jinkyoo Park

Mapping Embodied Affective Touch Strategies on a Humanoid Robot HumanoidEmbodied

affective touch human-robot interaction humanoid robot tactile sensors embodiment constraints

简要说明：本研究利用配备全身触觉传感器的iCub人形机器人，探究了情感触摸策略如何受机器人身体区域和物理约束的影响。参与者在不同触摸条件下表达情感，揭示了触摸表达强烈依赖于身体区域，并且在自由与受限交互之间无法直接迁移。

TLDR: This study investigates how affective touch strategies are shaped by the body region and physical constraints of a humanoid robot, using the iCub platform with full-body tactile sensors. Participants expressed emotions under different touch conditions, revealing that touch expression is strongly body-region dependent and does not transfer directly between free and constrained interactions.

Abstract: Affective touch in human-robot interaction is shaped not only by emotional intent, but also by robot embodiment, including touch location, physical constraints, and perceived agency or social role. Existing HRI studies typically focus on one or two isolated body parts, limiting understanding of how affective touch generalises across the full humanoid body. We present a study with 32 participants interacting with the iCub robot, which is equipped with full-body distributed tactile sensors. Participants expressed eight emotions under three conditions: free touch, arm-only touch, and torso-only touch. Results show that body region and spatial constraints jointly shaped both touch location and dynamics. In free touch, participants preferred socially accessible upper-body regions, while less frequently touched areas showed stronger emotion-specific selectivity. Emotion-related variation was more evident in motion features for arm-only touch and pressure features for torso-only touch. Touch strategies also did not transfer directly between free and constrained conditions, even within the same coarse body region. Participants reported increased closeness to the robot after interaction, with around 30 percent reporting a change in perceived social relationship. Together, these findings show that affective touch expression is strongly body-region dependent and shaped by embodiment constraints.

摘要（中文）：人机交互中的情感触摸不仅受情感意图影响，还受机器人具身特性（包括触摸位置、物理约束及感知能动性或社会角色）的塑造。现有的人机交互研究通常聚焦于单一或两个孤立身体部位，限制了我们对情感触摸如何在全人形机器人身体上泛化的理解。我们开展了一项包含32名参与者与iCub机器人互动的研究，该机器人配备了全身分布式触觉传感器。参与者在三种条件下表达八种情感：自由触摸、仅手臂触摸和仅躯干触摸。结果显示，身体区域与空间限制共同塑造了触摸位置与动态特征。在自由触摸中，参与者更倾向于触碰社会可接受的上半身区域，而被触碰较少的区域则表现出更强的情绪特异性选择模式。情绪相关的差异在仅手臂触摸的运动特征和仅躯干触摸的压力特征中更为明显。即使在相同粗略身体区域内，自由触摸与受限条件下的触摸策略也无法直接迁移。参与者在互动后报告了对机器人亲近感的提升，约30%的参与者表示感知到的社会关系发生了变化。这些发现共同表明，情感触摸的表达具有强烈的身体区域依赖性，并受到具身性约束的深刻影响。

Authors: Qiaoqiao Ren, Omar Eldardeer, Francesca Cocchella, Rea Francesco, Alessandra Sciutti, Tony Belpaeme

Nautilus: From One Prompt to Plug-and-Play Robot Learning Other

robot learning reproduction workflows plug-and-play agents unified interfaces automated validation

简要说明：NAUTILUS 是一个系统，能够根据单个用户提示，自动化生成可复现、可适应和可部署的机器人学习工作流，降低了跨方法族评估与集成的工程负担。

TLDR: NAUTILUS is a system that automates the generation of reproducible, adaptable, and deployable robot learning workflows from a single user prompt, reducing engineering burdens in cross-family evaluation and integration.

Abstract: Robot learning research is fragmented across policy families, benchmark suites, and real robots; each implementation is entangled with the others in a complex combination matrix, making it an engineering nightmare to port any single element. General-purpose coding agents may occasionally bridge specific setups, but cannot close this gap at scale because they lack the procedural priors and validation practices that characterize robotics research workflows. We propose NAUTILUS, an open-source harness that turns a single user prompt -- for example, "Evaluate policy A with benchmark B" -- into ready-to-use reproduction, evaluation, fine-tuning, and deployment workflows. NAUTILUS provides: plug-and-play agent skill sets with distilled priors from robotics research; typed contracts among policies, simulators/benchmarks, and real-world robots; unified interfaces and execution environments; and a trustworthy agentic coding workflow with explicit, automated validation, and testing at each milestone. NAUTILUS can not only automatically generate the required adapters and containers for existing implementations, but also wrap and onboard new or user-provided policies, simulators/benchmarks, and robots, all connected via a uniform interface. This expands cross-validation coverage without hand-written glue code. Like a nautilus shell that grows by adding chambers, NAUTILUS scales by extending its execution in chambered units, making it a research harness for scalability rather than a hand-curated framework, and aiming to reduce the engineering burden of cross-family reproduction and evaluation in the ever-growing robot learning ecosystem.

摘要（中文）：机器人学习研究在策略家族、基准测试套件和真实机器人之间高度割裂；每种实现方案都在复杂的组合矩阵中与其他要素相互纠缠，导致移植任何单一要素都成为工程难题。通用编码代理虽能偶尔桥接特定配置，却因缺乏机器人学研究工作流特有的先验流程与验证机制，难以实现大规模的系统整合。为此我们提出NAUTILUS开源框架——它能将单一用户指令（例如"用基准测试B评估策略A"）转化为可直接使用的复现、评估、微调与部署工作流。NAUTILUS提供：包含机器人学研究精炼先验的即插即用代理技能集；策略、模拟器/基准测试与真实机器人间的类型化合约；统一接口与执行环境；以及配备显式自动化验证机制、在每个里程碑进行测试的可信编码代理工作流。NAUTILUS不仅能自动生成现有实现所需的适配器与容器，还能封装并接入用户自定义或新型策略、模拟器/基准测试及机器人，所有组件通过统一接口连接。这扩展了交叉验证的覆盖范围，无需编写人工胶合代码。如同通过增加腔室生长的鹦鹉螺壳，NAUTILUS通过模块化执行单元实现扩展，使其成为面向可扩展性的研究框架而非手工定制的工具，旨在减轻日益庞大的机器人学习生态系统中跨家族复现与评估的工程负担。

Authors: Yufeng Jin, Jianfei Guo, Xiaogang Jia, Yu Deng, Zechu Li, Han Liu, Weiran Liao, Vignesh Prasad, Mathias Franzius, Gerhard Neumann, Georgia Chalvatzaki

Kairos: A Scalable Serving System for Physical AI Other

serving system multi-robot physical AI generate-execute loop task latency

简要说明：Kairos 是一个面向物理人工智能的多机器人服务系统，通过优化生成-执行循环，相比现有数字AI服务系统显著降低了任务延迟。

TLDR: Kairos is a multi-robot serving system designed for Physical AI, optimizing the generate-execute loop to significantly reduce task latency compared to standard AI serving systems.

Abstract: Physical AI is experiencing rapid growth with frontier foundation models increasing its capabilities across general environments. Physical AI tasks are characterized by inference properties that are markedly different from digital AI. They consist of multiple rounds of inference and action execution, generating a chunk of actions in each inference round, and asynchronously interleaving inference and execution. This makes existing digital AI serving systems unsuited for physical AI; a shortcoming that is critical for enabling their wide adoption, considering their size and the scale of the robot fleets they have to serve. To fill this gap, we design Kairos, the first multi-robot serving system that makes the generate-execute loop a first-class citizen, with active involvement in the execution phase. Across a wide range of physical AI models and robots, Kairos reduces the average end-to-end task latency by 31.8--66.5% over state-of-the-art digital AI serving practices, with gains scaling with the robot fleet size.

摘要（中文）：物理人工智能正经历快速发展，前沿基础模型不断提升其在通用环境中的能力。物理AI任务具有与数字AI显著不同的推理特性，其特征包括多轮推理与行动执行、每轮推理生成一组行动、以及推理与执行的异步交错处理。这使得现有的数字AI服务系统难以适配物理AI需求；考虑到其模型规模及所需服务的机器人集群数量，这一缺陷严重阻碍了物理AI的广泛普及。为填补这一空白，我们设计了首个多机器人服务系统Kairos，该系统将生成-执行闭环作为核心架构，并主动参与执行阶段。在多种物理AI模型与机器人平台的测试中，Kairos相较于最先进的数字AI服务方案，将端到端任务平均延迟降低了31.8%至66.5%，且性能优势随机器人集群规模扩大而增强。

Authors: Yinwei Dai, Ganesh Ananthanarayanan, Landon Cox, Xenofon Foukas, Bozidar Radunovic, Ravi Netravali

Learning When to Act: Communication-Efficient Reinforcement Learning via Run-Time Assurance RLRobot

Safe Reinforcement Learning Run-Time Assurance Lyapunov Communication-Efficient Control

简要说明：本文提出了一种强化学习框架，结合Lyapunov运行时安全保障层，共同学习何时行动以及施加何种控制输入，以保证控制任务中的安全性和通信效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework that jointly learns when to act and what control inputs to apply, using a Lyapunov-based run-time assurance shield to guarantee safety and communication efficiency in control tasks.

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) typically asks $\textit{what}$ an agent should do. We ask $\textit{when}$ it needs to act, and show that a single policy can jointly learn control inputs and communication-efficient timing decisions under a pointwise Lyapunov safety shield. We focus on stabilization around a known equilibrium, where CARE-based LQR backups, Lyapunov certificates, and classical Lyapunov-STC are well defined, enabling clean comparison against analytical baselines. A run-time assurance (RTA) layer overrides the policy via a one-step-ahead Lyapunov prediction and a precomputed LQR backup, providing a strictly stronger guarantee than constrained MDP methods that enforce safety only in expectation. On an inverted pendulum, cart--pole, and planar quadrotor, the learned policy achieves $1.91\times$, $1.45\times$, and $3.51\times$ higher mean inter-sample interval (MSI) than a Lyapunov-triggered baseline; a fixed LQR controller at the same average rate is unstable on all three plants, showing that adaptive timing, not a lower average rate, makes sparsity safe. A CARE-derived Lyapunov reward transfers across environments without redesign, with a single weight $w_c$ controlling the stability--communication tradeoff; ablations confirm the RTA shield is essential, with its removal reducing MSI by $1.27$--$1.84\times$ and degrading state norms. A preference-conditioned extension recovers the full tradeoff frontier from one model at $\tfrac{2}{11}$ of training compute, and SAC experiments show the results are algorithm-agnostic across discrete and continuous domains. A 12-state 3D quadrotor case study extends the framework to higher-dimensional systems where classical STC is intractable, and robustness to $\pm30\%$ mass variation and disturbances shows graceful degradation, with the RTA absorbing what the learned policy cannot.

摘要（中文）：安全强化学习通常关注智能体$\textit{应做什么}$。本研究探讨$\textit{何时}$需要采取行动，并证明在点态李雅普诺夫安全屏障下，单一策略能联合学习控制输入与通信高效的时序决策。我们聚焦于已知平衡点附近的稳定控制场景——该场景下基于CARE的LQR备份、李雅普诺夫证书及经典Lyapunov-STC均有明确定义，便于与解析基线进行清晰对比。运行时保障层通过单步前瞻李雅普诺夫预测与预计算LQR备份对策略实施覆盖干预，其提供的严格安全保障强于仅在期望层面确保安全的约束MDP方法。在倒立摆、小车-杆系统及平面四旋翼平台上，学习策略的平均采样间隔分别达到李雅普诺夫触发基线的1.91倍、1.45倍和3.51倍；同等平均采样率下的固定LQR控制器在三个被控对象上均失稳，表明稀疏化安全性源自自适应时序机制而非单纯降低平均采样率。基于CARE推导的李雅普诺夫奖励函数可在不同环境中直接迁移，仅需单一权重$w_c$即可调节稳定性与通信量的权衡；消融实验证实运行时保障层不可或缺，移除该模块将使平均采样间隔降低1.27-1.84倍并导致状态范数恶化。偏好条件化扩展技术能以$\tfrac{2}{11}$的训练计算量从单一模型恢复完整权衡边界，SAC实验表明该结果在离散与连续域中均具有算法无关性。针对12状态三维四旋翼的案例研究将框架拓展至经典STC难以处理的高维系统，在质量±30%摄动及干扰下的鲁棒性实验显示出性能的渐进衰减特性——运行时保障层有效吸收了学习策略未能处理的异常情况。

Authors: Adam Haroon, Erick J. Rodríguez-Seda, Cody Fleming, Tristan Schuler

Random-Set Graph Neural Networks AutonomousDriving

uncertainty quantification Graph Neural Networks belief function random set epistemic uncertainty

简要说明：该论文提出了随机集图神经网络（RS-GNN），这是一个利用信念函数形式对节点级认知不确定性进行建模的新框架，在包括自动驾驶基准在内的图学习数据集上展示了卓越的不确定性量化能力。

TLDR: The paper proposes Random-Set Graph Neural Networks (RS-GNN), a novel framework that models node-level epistemic uncertainty using a belief function formalism, demonstrating superior uncertainty quantification on graph learning datasets including autonomous driving benchmarks.

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification has become an important factor in understanding the data representations produced by Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Despite their predictive capabilities being ever useful across industrial workspaces, the inherent uncertainty induced by the nature of the data is a huge mitigating factor to GNN performance. While aleatoric uncertainty is the result of noisy and incomplete stochastic data such as missing edges or over-smoothing, epistemic uncertainty arises from lack of knowledge about a system or model (e.g., a graph's topology or node feature representation), which can be reduced by gathering more data and information. In this paper, we propose an original new framework in which node-level epistemic uncertainty is modelled in a belief function (finite random set) formalism. The resulting Random-Set Graph Neural Networks have a belief-function head predicting a random set over the list of classes, from which both a precise probability prediction and a measure of epistemic uncertainty can be obtained. Extensive experiments on 9 different graph learning datasets, including real-world autonomous driving benchmarks as such Nuscene and ROAD, demonstrate RS-GNN's superior uncertainty quantification capabilities

摘要（中文）：不确定性量化已成为理解图神经网络（GNNs）生成的数据表示的重要考量因素。尽管其预测能力在工业应用领域始终具有重要价值，但数据本身特性所引发的固有不确定性是影响GNN性能的关键制约因素。认知不确定性源于对系统或模型（如图拓扑结构或节点特征表示）的认知不足，可通过收集更多数据和信息来降低；而偶然不确定性则来自噪声干扰或不完整的随机数据（如缺失边或过度平滑现象）。本文提出了一种创新的框架，在信念函数（有限随机集）形式体系中对节点级认知不确定性进行建模。由此构建的随机集图神经网络（RS-GNN）通过信念函数头预测类别列表上的随机集，可同时获得精确的概率预测与认知不确定性度量。在包括Nuscenes和ROAD等真实世界自动驾驶基准数据集在内的9个不同图学习数据集上的广泛实验表明，RS-GNN具备卓越的不确定性量化能力。
